summary: Sketch drawing tools now place a point when the button or touchpad is pressed, not on the click that follows the release, and they accept press, drag and release. A drag places the press point and then the release point, so one drag draws a line, rectangle, circle or the first two points of an arc, slot or polyline segment. A press that travels no more than 8 pixels stays a click. A press within 8 pixels of the point just placed waits for the release: a drag draws from that point, so a touchpad tap followed by a tap-and-drag draws from the tapped point instead of placing the first corner on release, and a release without a drag places the short pick unless it lands exactly on the last point. Only a press that added a point draws on release: a press that finishes a shape, whose shape is rejected or invalid, or that opens a snap choice ends there, and so does a press during which the drawing is cancelled or changed from the keyboard. A second touch contact no longer lets the trailing click of a press place a point. Keyboard placement, snapping, relations and the trailing click are unchanged; the click after a press places nothing more.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, CAD files or controller output. Drawing input timing changes: points are placed on press, and a press within 8 pixels of the point just placed is placed on release instead.

checklist.schema: No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, CAD schema, storage, journal or worker reply change. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event, cancellation or input-version behavior change. WebMCP tools and their arguments are unchanged.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. Sketch drawing tools accept press-drag-release in addition to separate clicks.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change.
checklist.verification: CadSketchCanvasPicking.test.tsx draws a rectangle from one press-drag-release and from a tap followed by a tap-drag that arrives as a second press, keeps a small wobble as a click, draws polyline segments by press-drag-release, places a short corner beside the last point on release while a press on that exact point only grabs it, never retries a rejected or invalid completing press with its release point, ends a held press when Escape and a keyboard pick start the next rectangle, and keeps the trailing click suppressed when a second contact lands; each test fails without the change. The CAD feature suites, build, lint, ui:check, the release check and the Chromium specs that draw on the sketch canvas (cad-sketch-constraints, cad-sketch-dimension-points, cad-sketch-editing, cad-sketch-placement and cad-workflow) pass.

publicNotes.summary: Drawing responds on press and accepts press-drag-release.
changes: Sketch tools place a point as soon as you press, and one press-drag-release draws a line, rectangle or circle.
On a touchpad, a tap followed by a tap-and-drag now draws from the tapped point instead of dropping the first corner on release.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions, CAD files and controller output are unchanged.
